notes: VERDICT ON THE PAIRING: 15% belongs to Bathtubs and 7% to Other (not the reverse). Basis: (1) the same 2026 snapshot prints the activity 'Bathing 15%' (unambiguous in both languages), and bathing deaths happen in bathtubs; (2) the 2025 full edition prints Bathtub 14% and Other 9% for 2017–2021, a window sharing four of five years with 2018–2022, so a bathtub share of 7% is not possible; (3) in all four extractions (EN/FR, lifesaving.org and the Ontario mirror) the middle group reads '9% Pools <1% [lifeguard-supervised] 7% Other 15% Bathtubs', value before label, and the one pairing in that group that the text makes explicit ('<1%' with the lifeguard sentence) follows that pattern. I could not render the page, so a person should still glance at it. THE 'FULL 2026 REPORT' DOES NOT EXIST: lifesaving.org file 361108 is the one-page snapshot itself, and neither lifesaving.org, lifesaving.ca (the publisher's own site) nor lifesavingsociety.com lists a multi-page 2026 edition as of 21 Oct 2026. The latest multi-page edition is the 2025 Canadian Drowning Report (2017–2021), whose file is dated April 2026, so a 2026 full edition may appear in 2027. COUNTS: that 2025 edition prints no count per setting either; it gives shares and only two yearly averages (lake/pond 176, bathtub 67), plus the five-year total 2,424. I recorded its seven location shares, those two averages, the total and its four activity types as 2017–2021 rows, labelled so they are not mixed with the 2018–2022 snapshot rows. 2022 FLAG: the snapshot flags 2016–2021 as partial (two footnotes) and says 'Complete information for British Columbia was not available at the time of data collection', a sentence not tied to any year; 2022 is not flagged as partial anywhere. The 2025 edition carries the same 2016–2021 flag and puts its BC sentence on the province table (p. 19). Note that 2021 is flagged partial while 2022 is not, as printed. ACTIVITY SPLIT 2018–2022 (snapshot): Boating 22, Bathing 15, Aquatic 26, Non-aquatic 17; these four do not reach 100% and no further label was extracted (the 2025 edition's fourth type, 'Land, ice or air travel', has no visible counterpart on the snapshot). The boat-type figures (57, 9, 18 beside Powerboat, Canoe, Kayak) and the most-common-activity list could not be paired reliably and are left out.
